candidates.explanation: After the reset link is verified, the method only sets the new password and calls usersService.update. It never deletes the user's sessions. The refresh flow (AuthService.refreshToken, via sessionService.updateByHash) validates only the session id and hash, so a device that was already signed in keeps a valid session and can still renew its login. AuthService.update does revoke sessions on a password change, by calling sessionService.deleteByUserIdWithExclude around line 469. resetPassword has no equivalent call.

fix.description: In resetPassword, after `await this.usersService.update(user.id, user);`, delete all of the user's sessions, for example with `await this.sessionService.deleteByUserId({ userId: user.id });`. If no such method exists, add one to SessionService and its repository. Because the reset flow has no current session to keep, nothing needs to be excluded.
